title: Hold The Night
prompt: Soulful Amapiano-Afrohouse groove with rolling log drums, warm soulful piano riffs, deep sub bass and shimmering shakers, hypnotic and uplifting, spacious club-ready production, smooth expressive male lead with airy female background harmonies, warm velvety timbre
lyrics:
[Intro]
(oh, oh) feel the low end roll
soft light across the floor

[Verse]
City hums a slow blue tune
Footsteps chasing down the moon
We move easy, nothing planned
Your hand resting in my hand

[Pre-Chorus]
And the bass is calling out my name
[building energy]
Nothing here will feel the same

[Chorus]
[euphoric]
Hold the night, don't let it go (don't let it go)
Let the piano take it slow
We are rivers in the glow
HOLD THE NIGHT, don't let it go

[Verse 2]
Shakers whisper in the dark
Every heartbeat leaves a spark
Spin me till the morning breaks
Lose the weight the daylight makes

[Pre-Chorus]
And the bass is calling out my name
[building energy]
Nothing here will feel the same

[Chorus]
[euphoric]
Hold the night, don't let it go (don't let it go)
Let the piano take it slow
We are rivers in the glow
HOLD THE NIGHT, don't let it go

[Piano Interlude]

[Bridge]
[harmonies]
Slow it down, slow it down (slow it down)
Let the log drums hold the ground
Every wave will bring me round
Here with you I'm finally found

[Outro]
(oh, oh) hold the night
(oh, oh) in the light
